mapper.select: SELECT * FROM students WHERE is_deleted = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO students (full_name, furigana, nickname, email, area, age, gender, remark, is_deleted) VALUES (#{fullName}, #{furigana}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{area}, #{age}, #{gender}, #{remark}, FALSE)
mapper.update: UPDATE students SET full_name = #{fullName}, furigana = #{furigana}, nickname = #{nickname}, email = #{email}, area = #{area}, age = #{age}, gender = #{gender}, remark = #{remark}, is_deleted = #{isDeleted} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE students SET is_deleted = TRUE WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT s.* FROM students s LEFT JOIN students_courses sc ON s.id = sc.student_id LEFT JOIN enrollment_status es ON sc.id = es.student_course_id
AND s.full_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{fullName}, '%')
AND s.area LIKE CONCAT('%', #{area}, '%')
AND sc.course_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{courseName}, '%')
AND es.status = #{status}
